methodology.multiple_comparison_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q-values (q_corr_bh, q_overlap_bh) computed across all pairs tested in this run, since testing many pairs simultaneously inflates false-positive 'looks dependent' findings.
methodology.not_a_gate: This lab is diagnostic only. It does not kill, promote, or reweight edges. Portfolio-level treatment of these statistics is decided separately in portfolio_allocator/.
methodology.pairwise_test: Circular-shift permutation test. Edge B's daily return/active-trade series is circularly shifted by every possible offset (exhaustive) or, if that exceeds n_permutation_cap, a random sample of that many offsets, preserving edge B's own autocorrelation/clustering while nulling any real cross-edge timing relationship. Two-sided empirical p-values are reported for both the observed Pearson correlation and the observed max trade-timing overlap fraction.
methodology.random_matrix_theory: Marcenko-Pastur eigenvalue bound fit to the full edge daily-return correlation matrix (N edges, T observations, q=N/T). Eigenvalues at or below the bound are statistically indistinguishable from a purely random correlation matrix of the same shape; eigenvalues above it indicate genuine common structure. effective_number_of_bets is a participation-ratio diversification measure (N^2/sum(lambda_i^2)).
